versions.name: Scuba Diving
versions.description: Earn an open water certification and learn what breathing compressed air does to a body, from squeezes and nitrogen narcosis to decompression illness, along with the aquatic ecosystems a diver moves through.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
